name: syntheo
description: Search local Syntheo meetings or connect to Cloud with OAuth.

interface.longDescription: Find meetings and read notes, summaries, participants, action items, bounded transcript excerpts, and recurring history. On your computer, prefer the local Syntheo CLI or local MCP, including unsynced changes. For remote access, optionally connect Syntheo Cloud through OAuth. Cloud access requires personal or paid-Team Pro access and explicit Cloud API & Connectors opt-in, and reads separately uploaded snapshots. Local reads need no cloud connection. Export complete meeting records when requested.
defaultPrompt: What action items came out of my planning meeting?
Compare the last three meetings in this recurring series.
